def string_to_list(text):
    """Converts a string into a list of strings split by spaces."""
    return text.split()  # .split() handles multiple spaces automatically if needed, 
                       # but for single space it works exactly as required.

# Test cases based on your requirement and edge cases
assert string_to_list("python programming") == ['python', 'programming']
print("All assertions passed!")
